## Overview

This Adapter Validation Suite (AVS) instantiates the [UIAO_121 Adapter Conformance Test Plan](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/adapter-conformance-test-plan-template.md) for the `purview-audit` adapter. It defines the Tier-1 contract-conformance criteria, the controls under validation, and the integration test plan that govern the adapter across its lifecycle.

## Validation status

**Reserved slot — not yet implemented.** `purview-audit` is `status: reserved` / `phase: phase-planning` in canon. No adapter code exists yet. The Tier-1 criteria below define the conformance gate the adapter **must** clear at activation; they are a forward-looking plan, not a current result.

## Scope

Target surfaces / subsystems: `unified-audit-retention-tier`, `audit-event-coverage`, `dlp-policy-state`, `sensitivity-label-policy-state`, `information-protection-coverage`, `litigation-hold-state`, `insider-risk-policy-state`

**Validation artifacts:** `purview-audit-tier-findings.json`, `purview-dlp-policy-state.json`, `purview-label-coverage.json`

The suite validates that, for each target surface, the adapter normalizes vendor data into canonical claims, emits deterministic provenance, and produces KSI-anchored evidence — without mutating any source system (`ssot-mutation: never`).

## Controls under validation

The control roles below are mirrored from the adapter's companion [Adapter Technical Specification](../../../adapter-specs/purview-audit/purview-audit.html); the validation suite verifies that the adapter produces the evidence each role asserts.

NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 controls this adapter supports: `AU-2`, `AU-11`, `SC-4`, `MP-3`, `RA-2`

| Control | Role | Adapter capability |
|---|---|---|
| **AU-2** Event Logging | Primary | Audit-event coverage observation verifies which event categories are enabled and which workloads are in scope, producing the canonical evidence of what is being audited. |
| **AU-11** Audit Record Retention | Primary | Audit retention tier observation activates FINDING-008 as a live signal — Standard (180d) vs Premium (1y) vs 10-year add-on. |
| **SC-4** Information in Shared System Resources | Primary | DLP policy state inventory sources the control evidence for protections against cross-resource leakage. |
| **MP-3** Media Marking | Primary | Sensitivity-label policy state and Information Protection coverage source the control evidence for labelling and marking. |
| **RA-2** Security Categorization | Supporting | Information Protection coverage indicates how the agency has categorized information across workloads; gaps in coverage are categorization-completeness findings. |

## Notes from canon

Reserved slot per ADR-059. Read-only telemetry counterpart to the change-making Purview surface bundled inside the `m365` modernization adapter (modernization-registry, scope: purview). Continuously observes audit retention tier (Standard 180d / Premium 1y / 10-year add-on), audit-event coverage, DLP policy state, sensitivity-label policy state, Information Protection coverage, litigation-hold state, and Insider Risk policy state. Activates FINDING-008 (docs/findings/fedramp-gcc-moderate-purview-audit-180day-cliff.qmd) as a live drift signal in monthly ConMon packs (UIAO_132 / ADR-047) rather than a static one-shot finding. Sources control evidence for SC-4 (DLP), MP-3 (sensitivity labels), RA-2 (information classification) — closes three DRIFT-PROVENANCE registry-layer gaps for Purview-anchored controls.
